source_text: Adoraverunt deos alienos gentium in circuitu. Omnis cupiditas idolorum cultus. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: They-worshiped gods foreign of-nations in circuit. Every desire of-idols worship. Glory to-Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[They worshiped the foreign gods of the nations round about >> Bible:Judges 2:12]]. Every greed is idol-worship. Glory to Christ. Amen.
